notes: Perilla frutescens. Japanese culinary herb (ohba). Cinnamon-mint flavor. Self-seeds aggressively. High-margin restaurant herb.
harvestIndicators: Heart-shaped serrated leaves at 3 to 4 inches

seasonalTasks.title: Pinch off perilla flowers
seasonalTasks.body: Pinch off the flowers before they go to seed. Left alone, perilla self-seeds heavily and spreads.
